ail._doc: r53 AILMENTS (owner 22 Oct 12:10, Combat/BOAilments.h): the real ailments. bEnabled false = patch 20 (Burning/Shocked/Poisoned are looks only). Chances are % per hit carrying the element (+ the hero's IgniteChance/ShockChance/PoisonChance stats; a PoisonChance stat also poisons with Physical). Ignite: IgniteFrac of the fire hit over IgniteSeconds, strongest applies. Shock: ShockCoef x (lightning hit / life)^ShockPow % more damage taken, ShockMin..ShockMax (ShockEffect raises the cap to ShockMaxCap). Poison: stacks of PoisonFracPerSec of the hit per second for PoisonSeconds. Freeze: FreezeSecPerPct s per 1% of life a cold hit took, from FreezeMinSeconds, to FreezeMaxSeconds; rares x FreezeRareMult, bosses x FreezeBossMult (max FreezeBossMaxSeconds, then immune FreezeBossImmuneSeconds). -BOAilmentsOn / -BOAilmentsLegacy override.
ail._doc_ShockStackCap_r90: r90 META-BALANCE-A dp-080: stacked Shocks add up to at most this % more damage taken (absent = 60, patch 63). 75 = the 5th and later of the 8 slots count again.
ail._doc_PoisonTaken_r63h: r63h SKILLCODE (H14, #278): poison ticks are multiplied by the enemy's damage taken (curses, Hunter's Marks, War Banner, the monster's own) read at each tick, like the hit. false / -BOPoisonTakenLegacy = before.
ail._doc_MinionAil_r63h: r63h SKILLCODE (H16): a minion's hit ignites / shocks / poisons with the added chance of its summon skill (supports, lines; no base chance, no freeze/chill), owned by its hero. false / -BOMinionAilmentsLegacy = before.

curve._r88_early: r88 EARLY-GAME (owner 7 Nov: smooth sail to RL 100, everything melts; live pull 1306: hero dps 3x the model at RL 0-29, 8x at RL 70, 0.04-0.12 deaths per run): K 0.225 P 0.7 -> K 0.4577 P 0.55 = same life at ML 84 (Deep untouched), x1.13 ML3, x1.2 ML5, x1.3 ML10, x1.37 ML20-30, x1.31 ML40, x1.18 ML60, x1.03 ML80. Guardians use ModelDps life (unchanged). Revert = the pre values.

skills.Name: Bare Fists
skills.Description: Strike with your bare hands. Weak, but better than nothing. Find a weapon.

skills.Name: Slash
skills.Description: Your weapon's basic attack, no mana cost. Quick cuts at the enemy in front of you, three in a row.

skills.Name: Cleave
skills.Description: Cleave through every enemy in a wide arc in front of you. Your greatsword's mana skill; Slash is its free attack.

skills.Name: Arcane Bolt
skills.Description: Your staff's basic attack, no mana cost. A fast bolt of violet arcane force that strikes the first enemy in its path.

skills.Name: Zap
skills.Description: A spell: lightning strikes the enemy from the sky, then chains to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump. Your staff's mana skill; Arcane Bolt is its free attack. (The Lightning and Added Lightning supports put lightning on your other skills.)

skills.Name: Ground Slam
skills.Description: Slam the ground: a shockwave of dust and cracking earth bursts out in a cone in front of you, damaging every enemy it reaches, knocking them back and staggering those it hits hard.

skills.Name: Leap Slam
skills.Description: Leap through the air to the target location and crash down, damaging enemies where you land.

skills.Name: Ember Bolt
skills.Description: Hurl a ball of fire that explodes on impact, burning every enemy in the blast.

skills.Name: Frost Nova
skills.Description: Release a ring of frost around you, damaging and chilling every nearby enemy.

skills.Name: Chain Lightning
skills.Description: Lightning leaps from your hand to the nearest enemy, then chains between up to {Chains} more, a tenth less on each jump.

skills.Name: Toll of Dread
skills.Description: Ring the toll: every Woe in an area is consumed and each cursed enemy takes Poison damage, 10% more per Dread it carried.

skills.Name: Storm Whirl
skills.Description: Hold to spin inside a crackling vortex, moving toward the cursor; lightning lashes everything around you and strikes one enemy every turn.

skills.Name: Flame Dash
skills.Description: Teleport a short distance toward the cursor in a burst of flame, leaving a burning path that sears enemies standing in it. Every half second the path deals half the damage shown, for 3 seconds.

skills.Name: Winter Orb
skills.Description: Conjure every orb of ice you can hold (one to start, more from passives and gear) by your shoulder for 6 seconds. They hurl icicles at nearby enemies (faster with cast speed and Winter Orb fire rate), then shatter in a frost explosion that chills everything around it. At your orb limit, casting again shatters the oldest orb at once.

skills.Name: Storm Spark
skills.Description: Throw a crackling spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.5 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with lightning that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.Name: Ember Spark
skills.Description: Throw a smouldering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.8 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with a heavy blow of fire that sets it burning. It never chains to other enemies: it is the spark for the one enemy that will not die. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.Name: Rime Spark
skills.Description: Throw a freezing spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.7 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host with frost that leaps to {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies), a tenth less on each jump, chilling the whole pack. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.Name: Venom Spark
skills.Description: Throw a festering spark that latches onto an enemy. Every 0.4 seconds (sooner with cast speed and Spark strike rate) it strikes its host and {BrandChains} more {BrandChains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) with venom, a tenth less on each jump, and every strike adds a poison: the longer it crawls, the deeper they rot. When the host dies the spark jumps to another. Lasts {BrandLife} seconds. Each cast throws 2 bodies that land apart (3 from gem level 20); a recast adds more until all your Sparks are up (3 to start, more from passives and gear), then replaces the oldest. The spark is not a projectile: projectile bonuses do not change it. Tired of recasting it? Socket Cast on Crit in this spark: every critical hit from your attacks casts it for you.

skills.Name: Thunderfall
skills.Description: Strike three times with your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a staff or wand suits it). The third blow calls lightning down on every enemy in front of you. Its damage is lightning: all of it is converted already, so a conversion support, gear or tree node shares that 100% with it instead of adding on top. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.

skills.Name: Glacial Shards
skills.Description: Flick {Projectiles} shards of ice from your weapon (any weapon but a bow; a wand or staff suits it). Each bursts into frost on the first enemy it strikes, chilling everything nearby. Its damage is cold: all of it is converted already, so a conversion support, gear or tree node shares that 100% with it instead of adding on top. Spell damage modifiers also apply to it.

skills.Name: Living Orb
skills.Description: Become a living orb of fire and fly from group to group around you, bursting on every enemy near each landing. {Flights} flights: 4, 1 more at gem level 10 and at 20, and 1 more for each Chain. The last burst hits 60% harder. You end beside the last group you hit, or at once when you click to move or roll. With Ice, Lightning or Venom linked, the orb and its bursts turn cold, lightning or poison. Cast speed quickens the flights. Counts as a Movement skill. Only your own cast starts it: Cast on Crit and other triggers never do.

skills.Name: Reap
skills.Description: Your scythe's basic attack, no mana cost. A wide, hungry sweep that cuts everything in front of you.

skills.Name: Death Coil
skills.Description: Your scythe's mana skill. Hurl a coil of grave-magic that seeks the nearest foe ahead and bursts on it, rotting everything nearby.

skills.Name: Drain Life
skills.Description: Hold to tether the enemy under the cursor with a beam of grave-hunger: it rots while you drink, and the beam forks on to 3 more enemies nearby, each link a tenth weaker. A fifth of the damage comes back to you as life, and your minions drink with you.

skills.Name: Vampire Dash
skills.Description: Come apart into mist and bats and gather again a short way toward the cursor. The mist lingers on your path and rots whatever stands in it.

skills.Name: Unholy Void
skills.Description: Open a void of unholy energy around you: enemies inside take poison damage twice a second, 70% of the damage shown each time. The void gnaws at you too: 0.9% of your life per second, less with poison resistance, never the last tenth of your life. Press again to close it.

skills.Name: Gravereap
skills.Description: Sweep your weapon in a wide arc. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Thralls that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.

skills.Name: Marrow Lance
skills.Description: Hurl a lance of bone that pierces through the line. Enemies it kills rise as Risen Casters that fight for you until they fall: up to 3, and one more at gem levels 7, 13 and 19; a new one replaces the oldest. 40% of its damage is poison. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, where nothing dies, every 4% of its life your hits take raises one too.

skills.Name: Pyre Burst
skills.Description: Set a fresh corpse near your aim ablaze. It bursts in fire, hitting every enemy around it, and deals 10% of the slain's maximum life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as extra fire (20% at gem level 20). Your own fallen minions count as corpses. With no corpse there, your nearest minion is sacrificed instead.

skills.Name: Hammer Blow
skills.Description: Your mace's basic attack, no mana cost. A heavy blow at the enemy in front of you.

skills.Name: Holy Slash
skills.Description: A wide sweep that leaves a crescent of holy light, striking every enemy in front of you. Your mace's mana skill; Hammer Blow is its free attack.

skills.Name: Judgement
skills.Description: Raise your weapon to the sky: a moment later bolts of holy light crash down on the target and the enemies nearest it, one after another, each exploding on impact. {Projectiles} {Projectiles}|plural(one=bolt,other=bolts); one more at gem levels 10 and 20. The bolts are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them. Judgement is a Skyfall skill: every Skyfall line reaches it, and second fall lines (Twice Judged, Twice-Fallen Sky) drop the sky again where each bolt lands (each enemy takes one second fall per cast).

skills.Name: Orbiting Hammers
skills.Description: Turn on a ring of {OrbitCount} spectral hammers that sweeps out through the enemies around you and back again, smashing everything it passes. It drains 6 mana a second while it spins (more with supports); press again to turn it off, and it stops when your mana runs out. One more hammer at gem levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20; from five hammers a second, outer ring turns the other way and pulses out as the inner one comes in. Hammerstorm empowers it.

skills.Name: Consecrated Ground
skills.Description: Plant your weapon and hallow the ground around you for 5 seconds. Enemies on it burn with holy light, are slowed, take 20% more damage from every hit and are struck critically more often (+8% chance); you regenerate 2% of your life per second while you stand on it.

skills.Name: Holy Charge
skills.Description: Charge behind your shield toward the cursor and bash the first enemy in your path, stunning it. Where the charge ends, holy light burns the ground for 2 seconds, slowing enemies and healing you. The bash deals the full damage shown; the holy light deals 35% of it every half second. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

skills.Name: Pyre of Faith
skills.Description: Light a pyre of holy fire around you: enemies inside burn twice a second for fire damage that grows with your maximum life. The pyre burns you too: 6% of your life per second, a quarter of that at 75% fire resistance, never the last tenth of your life: you need life regeneration. Press again to put it out. Its burn is a Fire spell hit: Fire, Spell, Area and Holy damage scale it; Burning damage modifiers scale Ignites, not the pyre.

skills.Name: Hallowed Slam
skills.Description: Bring your weapon down on the ground in front of you. Where it lands the ground is hallowed for 3 seconds, one new patch a second: enemies on it burn for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second and take 8% more damage from every hit, and you regain life while you stand in it.

skills.Name: Shield Throw
skills.Description: Hurl your shield at the enemy in front of you. It rings off the first enemy it strikes into the next, up to 3 more times, a little weaker at every leap. A Shield skill: while you hold a shield it gains 1% increased damage per 5 armour, evasion and energy shield on that shield, and Shield skill bonuses apply. Without a shield it keeps its full base damage.

skills.Name: Quick Shot
skills.Description: Loose an arrow at the target. Free to use.

skills.Name: Piercing Shot
skills.Description: Draw the bow to its full and loose a heavy arrow that pierces every enemy in its path.

skills.Name: Split Shot
skills.Description: Loose a fan of {Projectiles} arrows. Each enemy is struck by one arrow. One more arrow at gem levels 8 and 16.

skills.Name: Rain of Arrows
skills.Description: Fire a volley into the sky. A moment later it rains down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times. Aimed at an enemy, the volley leads it: it falls where that enemy will be when the arrows land.

skills.Name: Wind Vault
skills.Description: Vault toward the cursor on a gust of wind (or back, away from it, when the cursor is close), shoving nearby enemies away on landing and loosing three arrows at the nearest. The damage shown is a full hit: each landing arrow deals 60% of it and the gust 15%. Cancels attacks. The arrows are not projectiles: Projectile skill bonuses do not change them.

skills.Name: Lightning Arrow
skills.Description: Loose an arrow charged with lightning. Half its physical damage is converted to lightning. When it strikes an enemy, lightning leaps from it to {Chains} more {Chains}|plural(one=enemy,other=enemies) for 72% of the hit, a tenth less on each jump. The first enemy takes the full damage shown. With no other enemy in reach, the leaps it cannot make come back into that enemy as one extra strike, so a lone boss takes about 29% more.

skills.Name: Ballista
skills.Description: Plant a ballista where you aim (up to 9 metres away) that turns on the nearest enemy and looses heavy bolts for 10 seconds. One at a time: the Multiple Totems support and the passive tree add more, and every one you add counts. Supports on this gem change its bolts. Each bolt pierces one enemy; with Chain or Fork linked it chains or forks at its first enemy instead.

skills.Name: Caustic Arrow
skills.Description: Loose a rotten arrow that bursts into a caustic cloud where it strikes, one new cloud a second. The cloud lingers for 3 seconds and poisons every enemy inside for 30% of the hit's damage twice a second. 60% of its damage is poison.

skills.Name: Fuse Arrow
skills.Description: Loose an arrow with a burning fuse. It bursts in fire where it strikes, hitting every enemy around the target. 60% of its damage is fire.

skills.Name: Twin Cuts
skills.Description: Your blades' basic attack, no mana cost. A quick cut with each blade at the enemy in front of you.

skills.Name: Flurry
skills.Description: A storm of five quick cuts in front of you; the last one is a heavy finisher that throws enemies back. Your blades' mana skill; Twin Cuts is their free attack.

skills.Name: Iaido Thrust
skills.Description: Dash through enemies toward the cursor, cutting everything on your line. A moment later you sheathe and they bleed for a second cut. The dash cut deals the full damage shown, the sheathe cut 38% of it. Every enemy you cut stays marked for 5 seconds, and each new cut on a marked enemy adds 25% of that cut to its mark: Sheathe makes them burst. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

skills.Name: Crescent Slash
skills.Description: A heavy cross cut with both blades. The cut flies on as a crescent wave that slices through every enemy on its line.

skills.Name: Shuriken Fan
skills.Description: Flick a fan of {Projectiles} spinning shuriken at the enemy. Each one cuts through {Pierce} {Pierce}|plural(one=foe,other=foes) before it stops. One more at gem levels 10 and 18.

skills.Name: Blade Vortex
skills.Description: {OrbitCount} spectral {OrbitCount}|plural(one=blade joins,other=blades join) a ring that circles you for 6 seconds, sweeping out into the pack and back, cutting every enemy they pass. Cast again to add more: up to {OrbitMax} blades. While it is on your bar, every basic attack that lands adds a blade.

skills.Name: Thousand Cuts
skills.Description: Become a blur of steel: fly from group to group around you five times, cutting everything near each one. The last cut is the heaviest. You end beside the last group you cut. Counts as a Movement skill and as a dash: movement supports, passives, items and Echo Cut apply (Echo Cut adds one more cut where you end). It is still a melee attack.

skills.Name: Sheathe
skills.Description: Sheathe your blades with a click. Every enemy your Iaido Thrust has marked bursts apart, nearest first, for 160% of its mark, and half of that to everything around it. A mark is the strongest Iaido cut on that enemy plus 25% of every other cut it took while marked, so thrust through it a few times before you sheathe. Needs marks: cut enemies with Iaido Thrust first.

skills.Name: Viper Fang
skills.Description: Three quick poisoned stabs at the enemy in front of you. Most of their damage is poison, and every stab lays a stack of poison that keeps eating at the enemy after you move on.

skills.Name: Moonfall
skills.Description: Leap to the cursor and fall on the enemies there with both blades. As you sheathe them a moment later, every enemy you struck is cut again for half the damage. Movement skill: cancels the end of an attack.

skills.Name: Cyclone
skills.Description: Hold to spin with your weapon outstretched, moving toward the cursor through enemies and cutting everything around you. Costs mana while you spin.

skills.Name: Shield Charge
skills.Description: Charge toward the cursor behind your shield, ploughing through every enemy in your way, and burst on arrival: the blast hits everything around you. Each enemy the blast catches gives back 1.5 mana. Almost no cooldown, chain it from pack to pack.

skills.Name: Earthshatter
skills.Description: Slam the ground so hard it splits: a fissure tears toward the cursor, hitting everything on its line. Enemies it kills leave a spike of rock that shatters a moment later, hitting those around it.

skills.Name: Rending Slam
skills.Description: Bring a two-handed weapon down so hard the ground rends: a shock runs out in a straight line toward the cursor, hitting every enemy on it. Your body is in the blow: 4% of your maximum life joins the weapon's base damage. No cooldown.

skills.Name: Wheeling Axe
skills.Description: Hurl a spinning axe toward the cursor. It cuts through every enemy in its path, then wheels back to your hand and cuts them again on the way.

supports.Name: Chain
supports.Description: Chains 2 additional times, each time to another enemy (never the same one twice): strong in packs, adds nothing against a lone boss. Each jump hits 8% harder than the last, so a full chain hits the last enemies hardest. 5% less damage. A projectile that still pierces flies on first and chains once its pierce runs out (a Ballista bolt chains at its first enemy). A Spark's leaps are not projectiles: they gain the extra leaps, but each leap still loses a tenth of its damage.

supports.Name: Multiple Projectiles
supports.Description: Fires 2 additional projectiles in a fan. 15% less damage. Each enemy is hit by one projectile per cast; the extras hit the pack behind.

supports.Name: Increased Area
supports.Description: 50% increased area of effect.

supports.Name: Concentrated Effect
supports.Description: 30% less area of effect. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage.

supports.Name: Added Lightning
supports.Description: Adds 1 to 6 lightning damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage, and +10% chance to Shock.

supports.Name: Added Poison
supports.Description: Adds 1 to 6 poison damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. The skill's poison damage penetrates 10% poison resistance. Supports Attack and Spell skills: any hit with poison damage can poison. Supported skills' poisons, bleeds and ignites deal 40% less damage. On a minion skill its minions' hits carry it at half strength.

supports.Name: Added Fire
supports.Description: Spells gain 2 to 5 fire damage, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage (not a summon's minions). Every skill gains 30% of its physical damage as extra fire damage: it counts the physical left after conversion, so it adds less with Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked.

supports.Name: Elemental Focus
supports.Description: 12% more elemental damage and 25% increased elemental damage, but the supported skill cannot Ignite. Damage converted to Fire, Cold or Lightning (Flame, Ice, Lightning) counts as elemental too.

supports.Name: Toxic Focus
supports.Description: 12% more poison damage and 25% increased poison damage: poison hits and the poisons they apply. Damage converted to Poison (Venom) counts as poison too.

supports.Name: Faster Casting
supports.Description: 25% more cast speed. On a summon of casters (Skeletal Mage): they cast 25% faster.

supports.Name: Faster Attacks
supports.Description: 25% more attack speed. On a summon: its minions attack 25% faster.

supports.Name: Elemental Penetration
supports.Description: Hits ignore 20% of enemy elemental resistance.

supports.Name: Life Leech
supports.Description: 1.5% of the damage the skill deals is leeched as life, and it deals 15% more damage while you are leeching (below full life).

supports.Name: Brutality
supports.Description: 12% more physical damage and 125% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). Deals no elemental damage. Linked with Lightning, Flame or Ice, the converted share is lost. Heralds of Embers, Rime and Storms add nothing to it (their extra damage is elemental); Herald of Rot still does.

supports.Name: Pierce
supports.Description: Projectiles pierce 2 additional targets. 10% less damage.

supports.Name: Spell Echo
supports.Description: The spell repeats once. 15% less damage. 10% less cast speed. On a channel it adds an echo pulse every 2nd tick at 90% of the hit. An echoed curse is 20% stronger and an echoed war cry's Resolve lasts 1 second longer. Never repeats a dash, a Vow, a toggle like Orbiting Hammers or a spell a trigger casts, and a triggered cast pays none of its price (a Spark still gains its extra spark body). Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Melee Physical Damage
supports.Description: 12% more melee physical damage and 75% increased Physical Attack damage (minions: 10% increased physical damage). 10% less attack speed. Works on melee minions. It scales only the physical left after conversion.

supports.Name: Controlled Destruction
supports.Description: 15% more spell damage and 30% increased spell damage. -40% to Critical Strike Multiplier. 10% less cast speed.

supports.Name: Bloodbound
supports.Description: The linked skill costs life instead of mana (20% more cost) and deals 10% more damage, another 10% more while you are below half your life. The classic way to keep a channel running on an empty mana pool: pair it with Siphon or Vow of Vigor.

supports.Name: Siphon
supports.Description: 2% of the linked skill's damage is leeched as life; attacks also leech 1% as mana. A totem's hits leech at 30% of that.

supports.Name: Tithe
supports.Description: Every hit of the linked skill returns 2 mana plus 0.4% of your maximum mana (attacks) and every kill 6 mana plus 2% of your maximum mana (spells, attacks and the kills of a linked summon's minions). On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) the linked skill takes returns its kill mana.

supports.Name: Woebringer
supports.Description: The linked Woe becomes an aura around you: while sworn it reserves 30% of your mana and lays the Woe on every enemy within 4.5 metres, more with area size on the Woe (Dread grows while they stay in it). Link it to several Woes and each one is its own aura, up to the number of Woes an enemy can carry (2 + your extra Woes), each reserving its own 30%. Press the skill again to end it.

supports.Name: Pass Sentence
supports.Description: When the Sentenced enemy dies, the Sentence passes to the nearest rare or unique enemy (else the nearest enemy) within 10 metres.

supports.Name: Gather Fury
supports.Description: Kills with the linked skill grant a Fury charge (at most one every half second). Fury: 4% more damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed per charge. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the charge. On a Guardian or Unique enemy, every 4% of its life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) the linked skill takes counts as a kill.

supports.Name: Bloodlust
supports.Description: Melee skills only. Each kill with the linked skill grants 1 stack of Bloodlust, a melee frenzy: 0.5% increased melee damage, 0.2% increased melee attack speed and 0.1% increased movement speed for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a minion skill half of its minions' kills grant you the stack.

supports.Name: War Banner
supports.Description: Retired: the War Banner is now a skill gem of its own. Any War Banner support you had became the War Banner skill gem.

supports.Name: Hunter's Mark
supports.Description: Projectiles and bows only. Each hit with the linked skill puts 1 Hunter's Mark on the enemy: it takes 1.4% more damage for each Mark, up to 10. The Marks fall off 3 seconds after your last hit, so keep shooting. Marks and your War Banner do not add up: an enemy takes the stronger of the two. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Woe Bearer
supports.Description: The linked Woe is borne by your blows: every enemy your hits strike takes it too, while it has room for another Woe (it never replaces one). The Woe can still be cast. Two Woe Bearers work at once.

supports.Name: Spell Totem
supports.Description: The spell is no longer cast by you: casting places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that casts it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only Projectile, Chain, Nova and Skyfall spells can become a totem (not Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Living Orb (you fly it yourself) or any Spark). Spell Echo and other spell repeats also echo the totem's casts, each echo dealing 20% less damage (a totem's pace ignores cast speed). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's casts. 35% less damage. A Totem's Judgement strikes for 60% of your own cast. For bow skills, use Arrow Totem.

supports.Name: Arrow Totem
supports.Description: The bow skill is no longer fired by you: firing places a totem where you aim (up to 9 metres away; 1 at a time, 8 seconds) that fires it at the nearest enemy every 0.8 seconds. Only bow skills that shoot arrows can become a totem (not Rain of Arrows, Wind Vault or the Ballista). The skill's other supports apply to the totem's shots, and Multiple Totems adds more totems. 35% less damage.

supports.Name: Multiple Totems
supports.Description: You may have 1 additional totem or ballista of the supported skill at once, and it recovers 20% faster. Gem levels never add totems; the passive tree and items can add more. 20% less damage. All your skills together stand at most 6 Ballistas and 10 Totems. Totems and Ballistas of one skill share their damage: each past the first adds 50% of one's damage.

supports.Name: Bone Guard
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill stay close and take on what comes at you. They have 20% more life, 50% more armour and regenerate 2.5% of their life per second. While one stands within 9 metres, you have 30% more armour plus 10 armour per level, and regenerate 1% of your life per second.

supports.Name: Ravening Host
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill range ahead of you and hunt, engaging enemies 50% farther away. They deal 12% more damage and 25% increased damage and move, attack and cast 15% faster.

supports.Name: Lightning
supports.Description: Turns the skill to lightning: 60% of Physical, Fire and Cold damage is converted to Lightning (Poison at half: 30%). Hits shock with 30% increased effect of Shock, and its Shocks stack: 1 more Shock can sit on an enemy. A spinning attack calls lightning down from the sky onto the enemies it cuts. (Not the Zap spell: Zap is a skill gem of its own.) Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

supports.Name: Flame
supports.Description: 60% of Physical, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Fire (Poison at half: 30%). Hits ignite. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

supports.Name: Ice
supports.Description: 60% of Physical, Fire and Lightning damage is converted to Cold (Poison at half: 30%). Hits chill; chilled kills shatter. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 40% left physical.

supports.Name: Venom
supports.Description: 30% of Physical, Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Poison. +25% chance to Poison. Poison hits ignore 15% of Poison resistance. Physical bonuses (Added Fire, Melee Physical, Brutality) only see the 70% left physical.

supports.Name: Skyfall
supports.Description: The skill strikes from the sky at its target instead of travelling (every chain target is struck from above; a bow's arrows drop point-first). A Nova falls on its target up to 9 metres away and blooms there. On Earthshatter a meteor of the slam's element falls at the end of the fissure. Only Projectile, Chain, Brand and Nova spells (every Spark), projectile attacks (not Crescent Slash's wave) and the Ballista's volley can fall; each enemy is struck once per use, and a projectile that falls takes your Skyfall damage bonuses, not your Projectile ones. A skill takes one shape: with Orbit, Rain, Trap or Totem also socketed, the first one socketed is used (a Totem or Trap always places it) and Skyfall adds only its Skyfall tag, so your Skyfall bonuses still count. Winter Orb and Orbiting Hammers keep circling, and Living Orb (you fly it yourself) never falls.

supports.Name: Tether
supports.Description: Each enemy hit is linked to up to 2 other enemies within 5 metres for 3 seconds; linked enemies take 15% of the hit's damage per second.

supports.Name: Swift Step
supports.Description: The movement skill has a 40% shorter cooldown and deals 8% more damage and 15% increased damage.

supports.Name: Channel Conduit
supports.Description: While you channel, your linked spell casts itself at the nearest enemy every 0.5 seconds for half its mana cost, with this skill's other supports. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. 30% more channelling cost. Works with Cyclone and every channelled attack. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

supports.Name: Honed Edge
supports.Description: +1% to base Critical Strike Chance and 80% increased Critical Strike Chance. Best on a build that already raises its critical strikes. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Deathblow
supports.Description: +50% to Critical Strike Multiplier: critical strikes hit much harder. Best with Honed Edge or other critical strike chance. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Orbit
supports.Description: The skill's projectiles first circle you for 1.5 seconds, then each flies at the nearest enemy (a bow's arrows circle nose-first). Spells gain +1 projectile. Attacks deal 25% less damage. Not on a skill that already circles you, such as Orbiting Hammers or Winter Orb (each keeps its own ring), and not on Crescent Slash's wave. Every projectile circles, up to 24 at once. Every projectile strikes; one sent at an enemy this cast already struck deals 75% less damage (an arrow or thrown blade 90% less: spread them over a pack). A skill takes one shape: Orbit keeps it circling even with Meteor Lore (the fall gives way), and with another shape gem socketed the first one socketed is used.

supports.Name: Unbroken Channel
supports.Description: Up to 25% more damage, ramping in over the first second of channelling. 20% less channelling cost.

supports.Name: Minion Damage
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill deal 12% more damage and 25% increased damage.

supports.Name: Minion Life
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill have 25% more life and 175% increased life.

supports.Name: Minion Speed
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill move, attack and cast 25% faster.

supports.Name: Fork
supports.Description: Projectiles fork into two on hitting an enemy: each flies on to either side for 70% of the hit. A projectile that still pierces forks once its pierce runs out; Shuriken Fan and melee waves fork at their first enemy and fly on, and a Ballista bolt forks at its first enemy.

supports.Name: Rain
supports.Description: The projectiles no longer fly: they go up and rain down on the target area, striking every enemy inside three times (four times with 4 or more projectiles). 50% less damage. A Ballista's bolts rain down on its target twice. Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers or Crescent Slash's wave: they cannot rain.

supports.Name: Trap
supports.Description: The skill is thrown as a trap (up to 3, 16 seconds). Not on Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash, Living Orb (you fly it yourself) or the Storm, Rime and Venom Sparks: they cannot be thrown. It is live the moment it lands and goes off the instant an enemy comes within 4 metres; its first strike deals 15% more damage, then it re-arms about a second later (sooner with faster re-arm). It also fits a bow Ballista. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby. 12% more damage and 25% increased damage. Your Traps out at once share their damage: each Trap past the first adds 20% of a Trap's damage.

supports.Name: Afterimage
supports.Description: Supported melee attacks are repeated once by a ghost of the swing. 20% less damage. On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Affliction
supports.Description: +35% chance to Ignite and +35% chance to Poison. 50% increased Burning and Poison damage. 10% less damage with hits.

supports.Name: Stormfrost
supports.Description: +25% chance to Shock and 50% increased effect of Shock. Cold hits build up Freeze 60% faster, and its Lightning damage is 15% more against Chilled or Frozen enemies.

supports.Name: Repeat
supports.Description: Bow skills fire 1 more time, a moment later (a Ballista fires each bolt twice). Channelled skills strike 1 more time inside each pulse. 40% less damage. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Cast on Crit
supports.Description:
What it does depends on the skill it sits in.
In a spell with nothing linked: the spell casts itself at the enemy struck when one of your attacks lands a critical hit, for 50% of its mana cost. All such spells take turns on one clock: at most one cast every 0.3 seconds.
In an attack with nothing linked: the attack strikes by itself when another of your attacks lands a critical hit. All such attacks share one clock of 0.75 seconds and deal 58% less damage in all (a Rain drops every wave, each at its share of the damage; Repeat, Afterimage and Multistrike never repeat it). Blade Vortex fills and renews its ring this way. In a channelled attack, its own critical hits release a crit pulse, its hit again around it, on that same clock.
With a spell linked (any skill that hits): its critical hits cast that spell.
Only attacks' critical hits set off the unlinked ones; a spell's critical hits cast only its own link. All your Cast on Crit share one 0.15 second clock, so one critical hit casts one skill. Triggered skills deal 25% less damage, must be on your skill bar and never trigger anything. Only spells can be linked. Movement skills, Sheathe, channelled spells, Heralds, Vows and auras never cast or strike by themselves. In a totem or ballista it casts only its own link, at most once per second.

supports.Name: Cast when Hit
supports.Description: Each time you have taken damage equal to 10% of your maximum life, the spell this is socketed in casts itself at the attacker, at most once every 0.5 seconds, for 50% of its mana cost. The triggered spell deals 10% less damage. In an attack, or to cast another spell, drop a spell on its link. One link per skill. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves. Fits totems and ballistas too: a totem's trigger fires at most once per second.

supports.Name: Cast on Minion Death
supports.Description: When a minion from this skill dies, your linked spell casts itself at the enemy nearest to where it fell, at most once per second, for 50% of its mana cost and with this skill's other supports. The linked spell deals 10% less damage. Drop a spell on it to link it; unlinked, it casts nothing. One link per skill: the first linking support socketed works. Triggered spells must be on your skill bar, are never placed as totems or traps, and never trigger anything themselves.

supports.Name: Rend
supports.Description: Physical hits of this skill have a 50% chance to cause Bleeding: 50% of the hit's physical damage each second for 4 seconds (the strongest bleed holds; 50% more while the enemy moves). 12% more Bleeding damage and 200% increased Bleeding damage. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Deep Wounds
supports.Description: +40% to Damage over Time Multiplier for this skill: its Ignites, Poisons and Bleeding deal 40% more damage. Hits are unchanged. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Gathering Storm
supports.Description: This skill's Shocks stack: 2 more Shocks can sit on an enemy (3 in all), adding up to at most 75% more damage taken. +25% chance to Shock with Lightning hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Contagious Flame
supports.Description: When an enemy this skill ignited dies, its Ignite spreads (100% chance) to enemies within 4.5 metres. While it burns, every second it also passes its Ignite to the nearest enemy within 3 metres that burns less. +15% chance to Ignite with Fire hits. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Shatter
supports.Description: Chilled or Frozen enemies this skill kills shatter: 12% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) as Cold damage to enemies within 3.5 metres, chilling them, and an enemy the burst kills shatters in turn. 20% increased effect of Chill. On a minion skill it works at half strength.

supports.Name: Melee Splash
supports.Description: Every blow splashes: enemies within 2 metres of each enemy struck take 55% of the blow's damage (once per blow). 10% less damage. Works on minions: their blows splash too.

supports.Name: Multistrike
supports.Description: The melee attack strikes 3 times: it repeats 2 more times and every strike deals 44% of the damage (56% less). On a skill with several blows (Flurry, Soul Rend, Thunderfall, Twin Cuts and Viper Fang) every blow is repeated, and every cut of Thousand Cuts. Works on minions: each of their blows strikes 2 more times. Repeats from a support gem and from your gear or passive tree stack, but the repeats from the smaller of the two deal 50% less damage.

supports.Name: Maim
supports.Description: Hits Maim the enemy for 4 seconds: it moves 30% slower and takes 10% more Physical damage from you, your minions and your allies. 8% more Physical damage. Works on minions. Only the Physical part counts: damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked) gains nothing from Maim.

supports.Name: Ruthless
supports.Description: Every third blow is a Ruthless blow: 60% more Physical damage and a heavy, bloody impact. Works on minions: every third blow of each minion.

supports.Name: Executioner
supports.Description: 35% more damage against enemies below half their life, and hits kill enemies left below 10% of their life (Guardians too). Works with bows and on minions.

supports.Name: Vicious Projectiles
supports.Description: 12% more Physical damage with projectiles and 100% increased Physical damage with projectile attacks, 10% less attack speed. Only the Physical part counts: it adds nothing to damage converted to an element (Lightning, Flame, Ice or Venom linked). On a summon it fits minions that shoot, at half strength.

supports.Name: Added Cold
supports.Description: Adds 3 to 4 cold damage to spells and attacks, scaled up by the skill's gem level like its own damage. Steadier than Added Lightning (1 to 6) for the same average: it chills where Added Lightning shocks.

supports.Name: Chain Detonation
supports.Description: Supports skills thrown as Traps. A Trap that goes off sets off your other Traps nearby, one after another. Traps set each other off at 100% increased distance, and each Trap further down the chain deals 8% more damage. +1 to the maximum number of Traps.

supports.Name: Volatile Dead
supports.Description: Minions from the supported skill explode where they fall: when killed, when their time runs out, or when a new cast replaces them past your limit. Each blast deals Fire Damage in 3 metres equal to 20% of the minion's maximum Life plus 50% of its hit damage. Recast at your limit to detonate your oldest minions.

supports.Name: Funeral Pyre
supports.Description: Enemies killed by the supported skill's hits burst into flame where they fall, dealing Fire Damage in 2.5 metres equal to 15% of their maximum Life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life). The burst is not the skill's hit, so what it kills does not burst again.

supports.Name: Inspiration
supports.Description: The linked skill costs 25% less. No damage of its own: it keeps a spammed spell or attack firing.

supports.Name: Economical Vow
supports.Description: The linked Vow or Herald reserves 20% less of your pool (a Herald 25% to 20%). Room for one more Vow or a bigger mana pool for your spells.

supports.Name: Wide Burst
supports.Description: The linked Herald's kill effect reaches 60% further: Embers and Rot burst over 4 metres, Rime shatters over 4.8 metres, Storms arcs to enemies within 8 metres. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.

supports.Name: Ruinous Herald
supports.Description: The linked Herald's kill effect deals 60% more damage (Embers 12% of the slain enemy's maximum life becomes 19.2%). Kills that chain into kills: a clear speed pick. The extra damage share on your hits is unchanged.

supports.Name: Lingering Woe
supports.Description: The linked Woe builds Dread 50% faster and lasts 50% longer on every enemy it touches (cast, channelled, borne by Woe Bearer or sworn with Woebringer).

supports.Name: Dawnbringer
supports.Description: Every third hit of the linked Holy attack calls a pillar of dawn on the enemy, dealing 50% of the hit as Fire Damage (at most once a second on the same enemy). For Holy Slash, Hallowed Slam, Holy Charge and Shield Throw; it stacks with the Dawnward Bulwark and Radiant Crusade, each counts its own hits.

supports.Name: Grave Conscription
supports.Description: Enemies killed by the linked attack have a 25% chance to rise as one of your Zombies while you have fewer than 4 (at most once every half second). Your minion damage and life apply to them, and if you also have Raise Zombie, its minion supports do too. Any attack build can grow a small horde.

supports.Name: Venom Bloom
supports.Description: Every fourth hit of the linked Poison attack bursts in venom: enemies within 2.5 metres take 45% of the hit as Poison Damage (at most once every 0.2 seconds, each enemy at most once every 0.5 seconds). For Gravereap, Soul Rend and Marrow Lance: a pack clear for poison melee.

supports.Name: Sanctifying Light
supports.Description: Turns the linked Holy attack to holy light: 60% of its Fire, Cold and Lightning damage is converted to Physical (Poison at half: 30%), so added elemental damage from your gear feeds your Physical bonuses, and it deals 8% more Physical Damage and 15% increased Physical Damage. The Paladin's answer to Zap, Flame, Ice and Venom; pairs with Brutality.

supports.Name: Whirling Host
supports.Description: The linked Orbit skill adds one more blade or hammer with each cast and its ring holds one more (Blade Vortex 9 instead of 8, Orbiting Hammers 4 instead of 3), each dealing 15% less damage. A wider, fuller ring that fills faster and catches more of the pack.

supports.Name: Conjured Pair
supports.Description: The linked Orb skill keeps one more orb at a time (Winter Orb: two orbs by your shoulders, both formed by one cast), each dealing 35% less damage. Twice the icicles over twice the ground: more coverage, a little more damage in all.

supports.Name: Rampart Strike
supports.Description: The linked Shield attack deals 0.8% more damage for every 1% chance to block you have (at 50% block: 40% more, at 75%: 60% more). Shield Charge, Holy Charge and Shield Throw: the block you build to live now hits back.

supports.Name: Deepened Woe
supports.Description: Every line of the linked Woe is 25% stronger: the damage it makes enemies take, the resistance it lowers, the damage they deal less and its slow. The Woe's own build, for when one Woe carries the whole party.

supports.Name: Tempered Aura
supports.Description: The linked damaging aura gnaws 40% less of your life (Unholy Void 0.9% to 0.54% a second, Pyre of Faith 6% to 3.6%). Stand in the fire longer: the support for life stacking aura builds.

supports.Name: Spreading Pyre
supports.Description: The linked corpse skill's fire leaps on to 2 more fresh corpses, one after another, each within the burst's radius of the last. Each leap bursts for its own corpse's life and deals 60% of the leap before it (Pyre Burst at gem 20: 10% of the slain's life, then 6%, then 3.6%). Corpses its own fire makes can carry it on: a pack goes up like kindling.

supports.Name: Defiant Roar
supports.Description: The linked war cry also grants a Fury charge for each Resolve charge it grants (Jarl's Roar into 3 enemies: 3 Resolve and 3 Fury), and that Resolve lasts 50% longer (10 s to 15 s). Fury: 4% more damage and 4% increased attack and cast speed each. The roar that holds the line now pays you to stand in it.

supports.Name: Rallying Standard
supports.Description: The linked War Banner lands with 5 Valour already raised, keeps all of its Valour when you move it (not half), and holds up to 10 more (20 to 30). Each Valour is 0.5% more damage taken by enemies near it: a banner you can carry from pack to pack and plant straight into a Guardian fight.

supports.Name: Focused Volley
supports.Description: The linked bow skill fires 1 more arrow, and all its arrows fly on one line at your target, each with its own hit, so one enemy can take every arrow. Each arrow after the first deals 60% of the one before it (2 arrows: 100% + 60%; 4 arrows: 100% + 60% + 36% + 22%), and the skill deals 15% less damage. A Guardian killer: you give up the spread. Arrows you shoot yourself only (not a trap, totem or rain).

supports.Name: Killer Instinct
supports.Description: Your linked minions strike for the throat: +4% to their base critical strike chance, 100% increased critical strike chance and +40% to critical strike multiplier. The crit support minion builds never had: your tree's minion and critical strike lines now have something to scale.

supports.Name: Ironclad Fury
supports.Description: The linked skill deals 2% more damage per 1,000 Armour, 1.5% more per 1,000 Evasion, 3.5% more per 1,000 maximum Energy Shield and 2.5% more per 1,000 maximum Life you have. Every 1,000 counts in full: at 16,000 Armour and 8,000 Life, 52% more. It adds into the same damage engine as the passive tree's lines that pay your defences. Any attack or spell, totems and traps too: the walls you built now hit back.

supports.Name: Kindling
supports.Description: Spells only. Each kill with the linked spell grants 1 stack of Kindling: 0.5% increased spell damage and 0.2% increased cast speed for each stack, up to 50 stacks. Each stack lasts 5 seconds, so keep killing to keep it up. On a Guardian, every 4% of its life (counted at Rupture Level 150 at most, without pack bonus life) the spell takes counts as a kill.
